description: Creates an alert on the linked SupaPark account that fires when a reservation time opens at a Walt Disney World restaurant for the given date and party size (each newly opened time alerts, even if other times were already open). Optionally limit it to a meal or a time window. Requires a linked SupaPark account (pairing key).

earliest_time.description: Optional: only alert for times at or after this, 24-hour HH:MM (e.g. "17:00").

latest_time.description: Optional: only alert for times at or before this, 24-hour HH:MM (e.g. "20:00").

meal.description: Optional: only alert for this meal (breakfast before 11 AM, lunch 11 AM–4 PM, dinner from 4 PM).

name: watch_dining
title: Watch a dining reservation
